LESSON: MY FAMILY FAMILY MEMBERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.4: My Family Family members

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about My Family Family members. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to know members of your family?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family
2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
3. explain why it is important to honour parents
4. identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family
   In simple words: practise until you can name family members in the nuclear and extended family. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
   In simple words: practise until you can draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain why it is important to honour parents
   In simple words: practise until you can explain why it is important to honour parents. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

4. identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused
   In simple words: practise until you can identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about My Family Family members using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about My Family Family members in the examples.
2. Explain My Family Family members to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My Family Family members.
4. Show that you can: name family members in the nuclear and extended family

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My Family Family members using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is My Family Family members important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song related to family relationships,
2. Draw a family tree and write names of family members on it,
3. List ways of respecting family members,
4. Type a poem using a digital device about respect for family members,
5. Sing a song related to respecting their bodies as the temple of the Holy Spirit,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to know members of your family?
2. Why are healthy family relationships important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family
2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family
3. explain why it is important to honour parents
4. identify whom to report to if touched inappropriately or sexually abused

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
